focus.name: menu-sound-test-shared-presentation-stream
focus.purpose: Bound the fixed scene-resource presentation stream shared by the options menu and sound-test screen while keeping the following alignment and palette objects separate.

evidence: Fresh instructions.json DATA references from the four direct stream loads
SceneResource_ProcessCommandStream dispatches command bytes below 0x20 and exits on command 0x00
Exact ROM command/text walk reaches the first command-0 terminator at 0x00128EB0
Both menu and sound-test callers pass the identical stream root to the shared interpreter
conclusion: The shared menu/sound-test presentation stream is bounded at its interpreter terminator. The following byte is explicit alignment padding and the following 16-word 0x0EEE source is a separately bounded provisional palette object; neither is absorbed into the stream.
